item.title: Join the 404 Run on April 4, 2026: Celebrate Atlanta’s spirit
item.description: The 404 Run, a 4.04-mile community run celebrating Atlanta culture, will debut on April 4, 2026 at Pittsburgh Yards, bringing together runners, walkers, and neighbors to celebrate movement, identity, and hometown pride. The post Join the 404 Run on April 4, 2026: Celebrate Atlanta’s spirit appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Trump calls on Republicans to ‘nationalize’ future elections
item.description: President Donald Trump has called on Republicans to "nationalize the voting" and implement a national voter ID requirement, while his administration pushes to overhaul election ground rules ahead of the pivotal midterm races this year. The post Trump calls on Republicans to ‘nationalize’ future elections appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Small Businesses are at the forefront of Atlanta’s mind ahead of FIFA World Cup
item.description: Atlanta Mayor Andre Dickens and business leaders announced resources and grants to help Atlanta entrepreneurs prepare for and participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, including the Showcase Atlanta marketing grant program, the Showcase Atlanta Youth Entrepreneurship Accelerator, and the Atlanta Business Readiness Loan Fund. The post Small Businesses are at the forefront of Atlanta’s mind ahead of FIFA World Cup appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Will Georgia’s Black male vote impact the 2026 election cycle?
item.description: Former State Senator Jason Esteves introduced his Black Men's Agenda during a roundtable event in Atlanta, which included plans for health, wealth, and opportunity, and was attended by over 100 Black men. The post Will Georgia’s Black male vote impact the 2026 election cycle? appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: Advocates urge Georgia Lawmakers to fully fund SNAP as federal cost shifts loom
item.description: Civil rights groups, lawmakers, and community advocates gathered at Rand Chapel of Central Presbyterian Church to urge legislators to fully fund the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) to reduce food insecurity for families across Georgia. The post Advocates urge Georgia Lawmakers to fully fund SNAP as federal cost shifts loom appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: East Lake Family YMCA, Drew Charter School to celebrate 6th annual Black History Parade
item.description: The East Lake Family YMCA and Drew Charter School are hosting their sixth annual Black History Month parade Saturday, Feb. 7, at noon. item.title: $28 million SoFu Commerce Center to deliver 300 jobs
item.description: A $28 million investment is set to strengthen one of South Fulton’s industrial corridors with the development of the SoFu Commerce Center, a new Class A light industrial facility projected to create approximately 300 jobs and significantly increase the local tax digest beginning in the first year of the incentive period. item.title: High Museum Opens New Photography Exhibit: “Blazing Light Photographs by Mimi Plumb”
item.description: "Blazing Light Photographs by Mimi Plumb" is a solo museum exhibition opening at the High Museum of Art, featuring photographs from the early 1970s to recent images taken during ongoing drought conditions in the American West, exploring themes of suburban expansion, political tension, climate anxiety, and uncertainty about the future. The post High Museum Opens New Photography Exhibit: “Blazing Light Photographs by Mimi Plumb” appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘All of Us or None of Us’: Georgia Nurses Call for Stop to ICE and DHS funding
item.description: Nurses and supporters gathered outside a VA hospital in Atlanta to honor the life of Alex Pretti, a former VA intensive care nurse who was killed by ICE and border patrol agents, and to call for the abolition of ICE.
